name: rocket

motions.note: optional: toggle visibility / scale along its local Z (glTF) for the motor burn; origin at the nozzle exit; emissive paint2, no transparency.

remarks: Origin = centre of the warhead's cylindrical body (identical to the `rocket` node origin in rpg.glb). Nose tip at +246.5 mm, nozzle exit at -482 mm, optional flame cone to -646 mm. Fin span radius ~64 mm, 6 fins, deployed.
Body colour comes from the `paint` material (olive drab); `paint2` (flame only) is emissive orange.
